_comment: Copy to watchos.config.json (gitignored) and fill in — scripts/setup.sh reads it. All values overridable by flags. Endpoints are ordered: first is the DEFAULT entry, the rest are failover fallbacks (SPEC §11). Doctrine (SPEC §11.4): the watch's embedded tailnet node is THE transport — list MagicDNS names (<host>.<tailnet>.ts.net) or tailnet 100.64/10 IPs; a LAN literal is reached THROUGH the tunnel too (works only once enrolled) and is never a shipped default. Unenrolled watches pair on-watch: Settings ▸ Gateways ▸ Pair.

tailnet._comment: authKey = reusable, non-ephemeral key from the Tailscale admin console (Keys ▸ generate). It enrolls the watch node ONCE (identity then lives in app data); re-enroll needs a fresh key. hostname = node name shown in the admin console.
